title: identity_snapshot v1
description: Summary of one read of the identity files. Emitted once per pass, after every identity_record of the same run_id, so it also marks the pass as complete. Emitted even when a file could not be read; then no identity_record is emitted.

passwd_status.description: read, unreadable, or implausible (no UID 0 entry).

passwd_error.description: Only when passwd_status is not read.

shadow_status.description: read or unreadable. Not attempted (unreadable, with an error saying so) when passwd was not read.

shadow_error.description: Only when shadow_status is not read.

records_emitted.description: identity_record facts emitted in this run_id. Only when both files were read.
